No aggravating and relieving factors. 65 yr old male patient with fever, chills and cough with haemoptosis"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHEIF COMPLAINT:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 65 year old male patient ,worker by occupation came to the causality with the cheif complaint of:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever and chills since 8 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChest pain radiating to shoulders since 6 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough since 6 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHemoptosis since 3 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDry mouth, polyuria, polydipsia, nocturia, decrease in vision since 5 years.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever is continuous and no diurnal variation, low grade and prescence of chills since 8 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough is productive, sputum is mucoid consistency and whiteish yellow colour sometimes blood tinged since 6 months , dizziness, chest pain on coughing and abdominal pain since 6 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHemoptosis with bright red clots\u0026nbsp; since 3 months. Burning micturation, constipation , passing the stools once in 3 days, vomiting one episode after intake of food every time since 3 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDaily routine: wakes up by 6 o' clock and does his daily chores and has tiffin and went to work and return home then had dinner and sleeps by 9 pm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnown complaint of diabetes mellitus since 20 years (on medication, glimperide and metformin)\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003EKnown complaint of hypertension since 20 years ( on medication,atenolol)\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003ENo known complaint of asthma , epilepsy,CAD.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBuilt: moderate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppatite: lost\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep : inadequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel movement: irregular( constipation)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMicturation: burning micturation\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo known allergy to drugs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHabits\/addictions:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe use to consume alcohol 20 years back of 1 bottle beer or a quater bottle of alcohol daily and also consumption of toddy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe had habit of smoking 20 years back 4 cigars and 4 packs of bedi daily\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENow completely stoped\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENO known relevant family history.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPHYSICAL EXAMINATION: I have taken the consent of the patient.
